name: Familiar Development
body:
You have put time and effort into developing your familiar.

Prerequisite: Ability to acquire a familiar

Benefit: Your familiar‘s abilities are figured as if you were 2 levels higher.

Special: This feat can be learned more than once and stacks with itself, each time raising your effective level by 2 when determining your familiar‘s special abilities.
